remarks: Look no further-this immaculate 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial on an oversized lot is truly move-in ready! This home has been meticulously maintained and tastefully updated. Spacious bedrooms, gleaming hardwood floors, central air, gas heat and gas cooking set the tone for comfortable modern living! Recent updates include recessed lighting throughout, refreshed interiors, and countless upgrades that make this home stand out. The newly fenced-in backyard offers both privacy and peace of mind, while the expansive deck is perfect for family gatherings, pets, and effortless entertaining. Ideally located within one mile of all brand-new shopping and conveniences, this property sits in a charming walkable neighborhood just minutes from both the vibrant Stamford Downtown and North Stamford. With nothing left to do but unpack, this home offers the perfect blend of convenience, privacy, and modern style!
